purpose: C-002 pilot: 5 items each for condition, exception, table, two-evidence combination, numeric change (artificial) and grounded explanation, on real korea.kr KOGL Type 1 policy briefings. Training/development pilot, NOT a final private evaluation set. Questions and explanation framing are assistant-authored (AI); every answer value, quoted evidence and condition is a verbatim span of the cited passage (checked by the builder). Not human-reviewed.
dev_rule: Document-level split chosen before writing answers so that each task type has one development item; every other document is train. All rows of a document, including distractor passages, stay in one split.
